scope: Primary licenses for every configured default server; dependencies and hosted service terms are separate

servers.name: Serena
servers.qualification: oraios/serena. Current version is after the project's v2 license transition; an older MIT-only description would be wrong.

servers.name: Context7
servers.qualification: upstash/context7. This identifies the connector code; hosted documentation/API service terms are separate.

servers.name: Playwright
servers.qualification: microsoft/playwright-mcp. The separately bundled browser, FFmpeg, and other helpers retain their own notices.

servers.name: GitHub
servers.qualification: github/github-mcp-server. GitHub account/service terms and bundled GitHub CLI notices are separate.

servers.name: Filesystem
servers.primaryLicense: Apache-2.0 with retained MIT contributions, per the exact source licensing-transition notice
servers.qualification: Exact published source license. npm says `SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE`; registry gitHead and lock integrity establish this source-notice mapping.

servers.name: Memory
servers.primaryLicense: Apache-2.0 with retained MIT contributions, per the exact source licensing-transition notice
servers.qualification: Exact published source license. This is Generic Memory, not the retired Obsidian integration.

servers.name: Sequential Thinking
servers.primaryLicense: Apache-2.0 with retained MIT contributions, per the exact source licensing-transition notice
servers.qualification: Exact published source license. See the original transition text rather than assuming a uniform MIT license.

servers.name: Fetch
servers.primaryLicense: MIT, as declared in this installed Python distribution
servers.qualification: MCP Fetch source. The installed version's full MIT text is preserved; do not silently replace it with a future source license.

servers.name: Git Local
servers.primaryLicense: MIT, as declared in this installed Python distribution
servers.qualification: MCP Git source. The bundled Git executable separately carries GPL v2 notices.

servers.name: Exa
servers.installedVersion: hosted endpoint; service build/version not published by this configuration
servers.primaryLicense: Hosted-service terms, not a locally bundled server-code license. Related open-source connector is MIT
servers.qualification: Harbor connects to `https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp`. Exa terms govern service use. exa-labs/exa-mcp-server is a related MIT repository; its license does not establish the hosted deployment's identity or replace service terms.

servers.name: Brave Search
servers.qualification: brave/brave-search-mcp-server. Brave Search API access is separate; its key and live acceptance remain intentionally deferred.

servers.name: Typst PDF Creator
servers.qualification: edward-lcl/typst-mcp. The bundled Typst executable separately uses Apache-2.0 plus third-party notices.

servers.name: PDF Tools
servers.qualification: rsp2k/mcp-pdf. Material separate dependencies include PyMuPDF 1.28.2 (**AGPL-3.0 or Artifex commercial**) and Pandoc 3.9 (**GPL-2.0-or-later**). Their collected notices do not by themselves establish source-distribution completeness.

servers.name: DuckDB
servers.qualification: motherduckdb/mcp-server-motherduck. Local DuckDB use does not require a MotherDuck account; cloud-service terms would be separate if enabled.

servers.name: MarkItDown
servers.qualification: microsoft/markitdown. The MCP wrapper and conversion engine have distinct version strings; optional service/dependency terms remain separate.

servers.name: Excel
servers.qualification: haris-musa/excel-mcp-server. This does not confer a license for Microsoft Excel; the local workbook tool does not require Excel to be installed.

servers.name: Word Documents
servers.qualification: SecurityRonin/docx-mcp. This does not confer a license for Microsoft Word; local DOCX operations do not require Word to be installed.

servers.name: DBHub
servers.qualification: bytebase/dbhub. Database engines, drivers, and any externally connected database service retain their own terms.
